import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
cameras = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot for price vs. megapixels colored by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=cameras, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', markers={0: 'o', 1: 's'}, palette='deep', alpha=0.7)

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Price vs. Megapixels of Digital Cameras by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type & 4K Video Capability', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
